sarah(sec): Quick check — auditor asked for a mapping of our RBAC change workflow to SOC2/ISO controls and a compact snapshot of KMS rotation events + proof that service-account privilege changes went through code review. Can we assemble a packaging plan by EOD? @alex(infra) @mike_oncall

alex(infra): Yup. Plan I'm thinking: 1) control-alignment doc (1p) mapping our RBAC change steps to control IDs, 2) artifact manifest (hashes + links), 3) CloudTrail/SIEM slices for KMS key events (last 18 months), 4) PRs + CI run IDs for service-account changes, 5) rolebinding diffs and screenshots, 6) emergency access log (signed approval). I can pull CloudTrail and S3 exports.

mike_oncall: Where do you want the event slices? Splunk or S3 pre-signed export? Splunk makes audit review easier but we need an export for evidence package. I can generate presigned S3 tarball and a short README.

alex(infra): Send Splunk query & I'll export. Example Splunk query I'll run: `index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=ScheduleKeyDeletion OR eventName=DisableKey OR eventName=ReEncrypt* OR eventName=RotateKey*) | sort 0 _time` — tweak as needed. For CloudTrail API: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2024-01-01` will give us raw event IDs to fetch.

auditor_jane: For the control mapping please include: which team gate approves RBAC PRs, the reviewer role (service-owner vs infra), and how we validate test coverage for role changes. Also we need a short annotated timeline for any KMS key rewraps/unwrappings in the last 2 years and the approver identity. Since this audit is crosswalked to ISO, show where key custody is documented.

lee(eng): Noted on test coverage — we enforce an integration test that deploys a minimal role binding to a staging cluster and verifies no excessive perms via `kubectl auth can-i` checks. I can add the CI job log snippet. Example snippet:

```
# ci job excerpt
kubectl apply -f tmp-role.yaml
kubectl auth can-i create pods --as=system:serviceaccount:team:deploy-sa
```

lee(eng): Also adding the rolebinding diff command we use: `git diff --staged -- path/to/rolebindings/*.yaml` — will include a sample diff in the package.

mike_oncall: On vuln triage — scanner flagged CVE-2026-1234 in one of our deps used by the key-management helper. Triage status: fixed in staging (PR 4621), awaiting prod rollout approval. I'll attach the triage doc with timeline and mitigations. Auditor: do you need the vuln CVE timeline in the same evidence bundle or separate?

auditor_jane: Put the vuln timeline in the same bundle under a separate folder called `vuln-triage/` — include PR, CVE summary, compensating controls, and when prod rollout happened. We want both preventative and detective evidence.

alex(infra): For KMS custody proof — we have key metadata from KMS: creationDate, keyState, keyRotationStatus, keyPolicy snapshots. I'll export JSONs and redact sensitive ARNs. Also include HSM/EKM notes for wrapped keys.

sarah(sec): Important — we must not include live key material in the bundle. Only metadata and signed approvals. Also redact IAM principal IDs when possible and provide a mapping file referencing internal identity IDs to names (not the full principals).

deploy-bot: deploy: evidence-export job started by @alex(infra) (job id: ev-exp-2026-04-15-13). Logs available: https://ci.internal/reports/ev-exp-2026-04-15-13

alex(infra): Upload plan: I'll create `evidence-package.tar.gz` in S3 under `audit-packages/2026-04-15/` and put a `manifest.json` at the root listing files + SHA256. Example manifest entry: { "path": "cloudtrail/kms-2024-2026.json.gz", "sha256": "b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184" } (we'll include real hashes).

lee(eng): For service-account PR proof, I'll attach the GitHub PR URLs and CI run IDs. PRs have required approvers: `team-lead` + `sec-oncall`. We'll include the review history screenshot as evidence.

mike_oncall: Estimated ETA: Splunk slice + S3 export in 2 hours, manifest + control mapping draft in 3 hours, vuln triage folder by EOD. I'll own bundling and presigned link.

auditor_jane: That timeline works. One ask — can you also include a short statement (1 paragraph) signed by the sec lead confirming that emergency key access was a one-off and authorized? The auditor needs a human attestation for any manual unwraps.

sarah(sec): I can write the attestation and sign (GPG sig) before packaging.

alex(infra): Action items assigned: - alex: CloudTrail/KMS metadata + Splunk export - lee: CI snippets + PR links + rolebinding diffs - mike_oncall: vuln triage doc + bundle upload + presigned links - sarah: control mapping doc + attestation. I'll tag deliverables in the evidence manifest.

mike_oncall: FYI I'll also add a checksum file and a brief README mapping artifacts to control IDs (SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9.x equivalent).

auditor_jane: Great. If you can drop the presigned bundle link here when ready I'll start initial review. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sarah(sec): Thanks team — ping me if anything blocks. I'll compile the final index for the auditor.
